policy: Explicit >= .90 is hidden by application worker; intermediate explicit or safety signals go to human review. Suggestive score alone is informational: clothed swimwear is permitted. No legal conclusion.

safety_threshold_notes.weapon: Validation precision >= .95; recall .326 on 749 positives, not a block threshold.
safety_threshold_notes.drug_visual: Conservative .90 review floor because small weak validation overestimates precision; not statistically calibrated.
safety_threshold_notes.graphic_violence: Conservative .90 review floor; only one known positive validation example, insufficient quality evidence.
safety_threshold_notes.extremist_symbol: Review only, visual symbol is not evidence of endorsement.

anatomy_cascade.note: Primary or reference routes intermediate explicit scores to anatomy; high suggestive routes for bounded crop confirmation. Reference alone never blocks. Thresholds selected on old validation; +47/2430 detected with +4/1885 false blocks versus prior policy, with unchanged model and compute.

architecture: Shared frozen backbone; V13 fine-tuned on 3794 new images, validation-selected 0.1 weight average with V11; unchanged safety and V9 reference heads.

multiview_policy.note: Development-driven rescue for illustrated nudity. Additional anatomy routing on high suggestive signal; one bounded crop. Weights unchanged. See regression report for false-positive tradeoff.

precision: FP16 weight storage with FP32 computation
